dataset: original DeepJEB v1.0, official CSV GRID coordinates aligned to source H5 geometry
purpose: Test a minimal linear-load displacement parameterization while preserving an independently supervised signed scalar stress field. This is a candidate physical inductive bias, not an established generalization result.

motivation_from_completed_work.Hash50_new_CAD_and_new_load_pilots: approximately 92% physical stress relative L2; pilots have historical experiment use
motivation_from_completed_work.independent_difficult_case_stress_fits: approximately 0.055% to 0.125%; supports conditioning/representation diagnosis rather than irreducible per-case fitting failure
motivation_from_completed_work.strict_PointNet_and_zero_global_context_: best validation mean stress relative L2 approximately 65.3%, deteriorating after approximately step1000
motivation_from_completed_work.pending_gate: Resolved by root: two local-feature seeds improve validation mean by1.6946 and0.8124 percentage points, with worse worst-case errors; physics uses actual local geometry without an unconditional improvement claim.

physical_contract.equation: For one fixed CAD, fixed material and homogeneous constraints with linear static stiffness K_g: K_g u = f; u(g,x,alpha) = sum_j alpha_j B_j(g,x).
physical_contract.basis_units: Each column B_j is the physical displacement in mm at the corresponding printed canonical load amplitude; it is not a unit-force or unit-moment column.
physical_contract.general_alpha_definition: Using that CAD's verified printed basis amplitudes, alpha_ver=Fz/Fz_ver, alpha_hor=Fx/Fx_hor (the signed negative denominator is retained), alpha_tor=Mz/Mz_tor. Check the complete printed force and moment vectors separately; never combine N and Nmm into an unscaled norm.
physical_contract.dia_is_not_convex: The two nonzero coefficients sum to 1.6303370601648126; this is a load-span test, not a convex interpolation claim.
essential_exclusions: Do not assume the documented one-CAD amplitudes or coefficients are identical on every CAD without metadata verification.
Do not infer full six-component load support from a rank3 dataset.
Do not hard-code a basis selected by load name while silently dropping the actual printed load amplitude/sign.
Do not mix, relabel, or fabricate the source signed scalar stress by applying the displacement coefficients.
Do not infer a stress tensor, constitutive stress scalar, equilibrium residual, or a zero prescribed-displacement offset from unavailable labels.

metadata_prerequisites_before_implementa.scope: Only the 40 train and 5 validation CADs; deck/BC metadata and the already permitted ver/hor/tor input arrays. No dia field archive or final-test field is needed.
checks: For each selected CAD, confirm same geometry, material, coordinate frame, fixed support/RBE constraints and load-distribution/RBE3 reference across ver/hor/tor; prescribed support displacement must be homogeneous zero.
Compare canonical normalized xyz/node-order hashes and load-independent feature slots across the three permitted load archives; retain the current CSV-to-geometry alignment guard.

Zero features[:,7:13] and require all remaining existing 25-channel input slots to agree across the three loads for the same CAD. Fail explicitly if a load-dependent BC has been left in the basis inputs.

Use already verified deck/BC metadata to record that CAD's signed force/moment basis and its rank3 contract; force and moment units are checked separately. Metadata containing the printed dia load vector may be inspected without opening dia field labels.

If a selected CAD violates fixed linear homogeneous-BC prerequisites, stop the stage and report it; do not silently remove it after inspecting its fitting error or infer coefficients by regressing held-out displacement labels.
metadata_prerequisites_before_implementa.not_yet_verified_by_this_plan: The one-CAD deck evidence supports the design; validity of K linearity at applied amplitudes and numerical source-field superposition have not been measured.
metadata_prerequisites_before_implementa.metadata_guard_completed: 45 real decks plus canonicalver prepared force slots verified, source notes/geobc_load_basis_45.json; runtime additionally verifies every permitted archive alpha and load-independent xyz/features hashes.

recommended_minimal_candidate.execution_order: First isolate the displacement mechanism with an independent displacement branch and a frozen strict-supervised stress branch. A coupled joint optimization is deferred.

displacement_basis_branch.model_reuse: ConditionedField(out_channels=9), official TCNN hashgrid/FullyFusedMLP, from-scratch parameters
displacement_basis_branch.global_context: PointNet,32-dimensional context; canonical1024-node clouds, same layout/seed for both variants.
displacement_basis_branch.local_features: Frozen actual13-dimensional boundary-node features for both variants; loader also supports none/zero for future explicit contracts.
displacement_basis_branch.static_inputs: Normalized xyz, unchanged support/load-location/material/length inputs, chosen target-independent local geometry, fixed global-context layout; all six force/moment slots are zeroed for every call.
displacement_basis_branch.zero_load: alpha=0 gives exactly zero displacement; no additive intercept is decoded.
displacement_basis_branch.load_invariance: The basis network receives no load amplitude/name/ID and the same CAD-static inputs for all loads; load coefficients act only in the final linear composition.
displacement_basis_branch.training_supervision: On ver/hor/tor, alpha is one-hot, so the observed signed 3-vector supervises the corresponding basis column. No fabricated mixed-load or dia target is constructed.
displacement_basis_branch.sampler: Reuse four distinct permitted cases per update, equal 12800 sampled original nodes per case with replacement; total batch51200. Case and node generators remain independent of model initialization.
displacement_basis_branch.cache_policy: Cache immutable coordinates/local features/clouds only during training. Basis outputs may be reused across loads of the same CAD only inside an eval no_grad pass, never across optimizer updates.

stress_branch.target: Original signed scalar stress in MPa, not displacement resultant or tensor components
stress_branch.model: Retain a separately supervised load-conditioned scalar field using the full original force/moment feature slots
stress_branch.first_pair_policy: Freeze the selected best checkpoint from the current strict 40train/5validation stress experiments. Its train-only scaler and source contract are preserved; both displacement variants share exactly this stress branch.
stress_branch.prohibited_checkpoint: Do not use Hash50 weights/scaler as the strict stress branch: that historical model trained on CADs now assigned to the locked final test group.
stress_branch.independence: No displacement-loss gradient updates the frozen scalar stress parameters in this first pair. Do not claim that the displacement structural constraint has improved stress.
stress_branch.evaluation_reuse: Carry the existing selected strict all-node train/validation stress metrics, not a redundant stress reevaluation. For new allowed queries, call this branch independently. Dia stress, if later unsealed, remains a separately measured extrapolation diagnostic and is never linearly composed.

exact_paired_control.one_difference: The control receives the full existing force/moment slots; the linear candidate zeroes exactly these six slots. Both have the same 9-output network, the same final alpha composition, and all other inputs and hyperparameters are identical.
exact_paired_control.control_formula: u_control(g,x,alpha) = u_scale_mm * sum_j alpha_j B_control_j(g,x,alpha); allowing alpha in the decoder removes the fixed-basis superposition constraint while preserving output dimensionality and parameter count.
exact_paired_control.capacity_statement: Record native TCNN padded parameter count and input/output layout for both; do not compare a9-output candidate against an unreported3-output decoder as if their capacity/initialization were necessarily identical.
exact_paired_control.paired_initialization: Construct the same native input/output dimensions with the same seed2026 and official pinned TCNN implementation. Record initial native-parameter equality as a small check before the first update; no weights are imported from historical all50 training.
exact_paired_control.paired_sampling: Use NumPy default_rng(seed+23) for case selection and torch.Generator(device).manual_seed(seed+17) for node sampling; save and restore both generators independently. Same eval schedule does not consume either sampler stream.
exact_paired_control.paired_auxiliary_state: Identical immutable local features/clouds, split, canonical node ordering, scalers, Adam settings, precision flags, total queried nodes and scalar stress checkpoint

proposed_initial_budget.optimizer: Adam, fused on CUDA, betas0.9/0.999, epsilon1e-8, no weight decay

exact_paired_control.budget_reason: Root fixed10k updates/eval1k, width128/PointNet/localactual/seed2026 after both local-feature seeds completed; do not revise using dia/final-test results.
exact_paired_control.fair_timing: Record training and full-node eval wall times separately. The load-independent candidate can evaluate a CAD's basis once and compose three loads; the control must evaluate each load. This implementation advantage is reported, not disguised as an equal number of evaluation forward calls.

train_only_scalers.fit_scope: Exactly40 train CADs x ver,hor,tor, all original aligned nodes; no validation, dia, or final-test labels

stress.type: Existing StressScaler, preserved from the selected strict stress checkpoint
stress.note: Centered nonlinear stress scaling is allowed only on the independent scalar branch; it must not be applied to displacement basis outputs.

displacement.type: One shared positive scalar RMS in mm, exactly zero center, no nonlinear transform
displacement.basis_encode: All nine basis outputs use this same scalar; composition commutes exactly with physical decoding.
displacement.fit_method: Stream float64 sums of squares and node counts over the explicitly allowed training archives; do not concatenate all135 cases on GPU to fit a scaler.
displacement.forbidden: Do not reuse FieldScaler's nonzero mean or asinh for displacement; weighted sums of centered decoded basis outputs would introduce the wrong offset because dia coefficients sum to1.6303370601648126, not1.

train_only_scalers.reuse_and_resume: Fit once from the training allowlist, serialize exact values/counts/scope; validation and inference consume the serialized scalers directly. Resume must match the saved contract and scalers rather than fitting any newly allowed labels.

loss_and_checkpoint_selection.initial_pair_u_loss: Mean squared error over all3 signed displacement components after the common zero-center train RMS scaling; equal node counts per selected case produce equal case weighting within an update.
loss_and_checkpoint_selection.displacement_checkpoint_selection: Minimum validation15-case mean all-original-node physical displacement vector relativeL2; tie keeps the earlier checkpoint. Train metrics and all dia/final-test metrics do not select.
loss_and_checkpoint_selection.stress_selection: The frozen strict stress branch retains its earlier validation signed-stress case-mean relativeL2 selection; no displacement/dia target changes it.
loss_and_checkpoint_selection.single_combined_best_caveat: The independent branches have explicitly separate selected checkpoint paths and scores; do not claim a single jointly selected best update.

joint_extension_deferred.status: not part of initial pair; requires a separate root decision and a fresh matched control
joint_extension_deferred.minimal_possible_joint_layout: Share only a load-independent geometry encoder if helpful; maintain a9-output load-independent displacement decoder and a separate load-conditioned signed scalar decoder. Do not feed full load features into a shared displacement trunk.
joint_extension_deferred.objective_and_selection: Predeclare normalized loss weights and a validation-only selection rule before training. Auxiliary-u improvements in stress require comparison to the matched no-u control; the independent-pair results cannot establish this.
joint_extension_deferred.reason_for_deferral: Two coupled objectives or a new stress selection rule would confound the first test of exact displacement load linearity.

validation.purpose: checkpoint selection and geometry transfer diagnostics

permitted_now_after_root_gate.all_nodes: Every original aligned node, float64 physical decoded metrics, no clipping/downsampling/error weights or truncation

u_aggregates: pooled Frobenius relativeL2 over all allowed nodes/components
metrics.stress: Preserve independently supervised physical signed-stress relativeL2, top ceil(1%N) |truth| hotspot relativeL2, maximum absoluteMPa error, case mean/worst/pooled
metrics.no_resultant_target: A displacement magnitude may be a display/metric only; never replace the signed3-component target with magnitude or sqrt-resultant inference.

minimum_saved_artifacts: config with static/load slot contract, basis order, per-CAD load amplitudes and alpha source, exact train-only scalers, native dimensions/commit/parameter counts, source identities and precision
best.pt and last.pt with Adam, step, committed metrics/history best, both sampler states and model RNG states
all-node train/validation metrics history and completed summary with separate stress/u checkpoint references
at most four allowed representative prediction files and index: xyz, sample_key, alpha, signed u_true/u_pred, physical units, basis output layout; stress reference remains independent
status/ETA and coordinator-ready gate; existing completed outputs are reused only with compatible contracts

frozen_dia_validation.current_status: Still locked; implementation authorization and readiness do not authorize reading dia/final-test fields. Root maintains a separate frozen-evaluation gate.
freeze_before_opening: Choose architecture/local-input choice, seed, budget, scalers, coefficient derivation and all metrics/interpretation rules using train and permitted validation loads only.
Select each branch using its declared permitted validation rule; persist immutable checkpoint/source references and the frozen model contract.
Root explicitly enables the held-out-load evaluation after reviewing local geometry and the displacement pair. No dia-based model/scaler/coefficient adjustment is allowed.
frozen_dia_validation.suggested_first_unseal: The5 validation CADs' dia fields only; this is a frozen held-out-load diagnostic on validation CADs, not final-test performance. Keep all5 final-test CAD field archives locked.
measurements_once_unsealed: Oracle solver/label superposition residual: r_oracle=u_true_dia-c_ver*u_true_ver-c_hor*u_true_hor-c_tor*u_true_tor, with source-verified per-CAD coefficients; report full-node relativeL2, RMSEmm and max vector normmm.
Frozen candidate and paired-control physical dia displacement errors, equal-case mean/worst/pooled, on exactly the same nodes.
Model internal superposition residual as an implementation check only: exact by construction for the linear candidate and not evidence that the FEM truth relation holds.

If scalar stress is queried, measure the separately supervised frozen scalar branch directly on original dia signed labels. Do not compare synthesized scalar stress labels or claim displacement linearity guarantees stress-scalar extrapolation.
hypotheses_only_this_step_can_verify: Printed rank3 load-span coefficients actually produce the numerical source displacement field, within observed solver/CSV rounding error.
The stated linear small-displacement fixed-BC assumption is numerically compatible with dia output at these applied amplitudes; metadata alone does not prove this.
The exactly linear displacement parameterization transfers better than the matched load-dependent control to the unseen direction for the frozen selected models.
Two canonical-basis prediction errors do not cancel or amplify enough to reverse the expected dia benefit; this cannot be inferred just from seen-load means.
frozen_dia_validation.oracle_tolerance_policy: Report raw values and source precision; no numeric solver-consistency tolerance is currently evidenced. Do not tune coefficients or choose a convenient acceptance threshold from dia results. Any required pass/fail tolerance must be justified and fixed before unsealing.
frozen_dia_validation.if_oracle_relation_fails: Report a negative physical-assumption result and keep the original signed fields; do not train on synthetic dia targets or silently redefine the basis.
frozen_dia_validation.final_test: Five official-test CADs remain isolated. After the research choices are frozen and a separate release gate is granted, evaluate their ver/hor/tor geometry-transfer and dia geometry-plus-load results once; no changes follow those results.

reusable_components: serial coordinator and committed-resume artifact pattern
implementation_handoff_if_root_later_acc.new_loader_contract: Open only explicit train/validation ver/hor/tor prepared NPZs; read displacement/u[N,3] rawmm alongside verified xyz/features/key/alignment. Build one CAD-static feature record after zeroing load slots, and record each case's alpha. A new zero-center RMS scaler is necessary; do not alter current StressScaler or current benchmark scaler behavior.
implementation_handoff_if_root_later_acc.forward_basis_interface: PhysicsField.response_basis(xyz[N,3],features[N,25|38],context=None,cad_index=None)->scaled_basis[N,basis3,component3]; module zeroes7:13 only in linear_basis mode
implementation_handoff_if_root_later_acc.compose_interface: PhysicsField.forward(xyz,features,alpha[N,3],...)->scaled_u[N,3]; DisplacementScaler.decode scales by common positive scale_mm without offset
minimal_CPU_checks: exact homogeneity/superposition on arbitrary synthetic alpha at fixed input
paired sampler/checkpoint restore and validation-only selection
implementation_handoff_if_root_later_acc.one_short_GPU_check_only_after_queue_gat: Check native9-output dimensions, signed finite forward/backward and memory at intended sampled batch once; no simultaneous GPU job or redundant long profile.
implementation_handoff_if_root_later_acc.launch_rule: Implementation is authorized and root fixed the stage. Native GPU dispatch waits only for notes/physics_trainer_ready.json; this child starts no GPU job and freezes source after writing ready.
